theorems.statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (α : ℝ), 1 ≤ m → 0 < α → ∀ (f : Euclid m → (Euclid m →L[ℝ] Euclid k)) (x₀ : Euclid m) (R h₀ C : ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < h₀ → ContinuousOn f (ball x₀ R) → (∀ v : Euclid m, ‖v‖ = 1 → ∀ t : ℝ, t ≠ 0 → |t| < h₀ → (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, ‖t⁻¹ • (f (x + t • v) - f x)‖ ≤ C) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, ∀ y ∈ ball x₀ R, ‖t⁻¹ • (f (x + t • v) - f x) - t⁻¹ • (f (y + t • v) - f y)‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f (ball x₀ R) ∧ (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ C) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball x₀ R, ∀ y ∈ ball x₀ R, ‖fderiv ℝ f x - fderiv ℝ f y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
